# Stellaris Star

Stellaris Star provides China company registration and corporate secretarial coordination for foreign founders.

## Localized brand promise
- English: Affordable online setup. Real local support.
- Korean: 부담을 낮춘 온라인 설립, 필요할 때 이어지는 중국 현지 지원.
- Arabic: تأسيس إلكتروني ميسور ودعم محلي حقيقي عند الحاجة.
- Russian: Доступный онлайн-старт и реальная местная поддержка.


## Final public offer
- Standard China company-registration service fee: US$99.
- Included standard scope: online eligibility assessment, digital information collection, basic company-name assistance, standard business-scope and registration-document preparation, filing coordination, progress updates and English-language customer support.
- US$99 is not an all-inclusive China setup price. Registered address, government and third-party fees, translation or authentication, licences, tax and accounting, banking, immigration, trademark and sourcing services are quoted separately when required.
- Registration, bank accounts, licences, visas, work permits and residence permits are never guaranteed.

## Core value
- Online application with a clear checklist and progress route.
- Real local human support for complex cases.
- Optional connections to accounting, banking, immigration, suppliers and professional services.
- WhatsApp enquiries acknowledged within 30 minutes during Mon–Fri, 09:00–18:00 China time (UTC+8).
